The diphthongs ou and ow can also make the same vowel sound. At the beginning of a word or in the middle of a word, you have to remember which spelling to use. At the end of a word, only the ow spelling is used.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about beaver dams.

paragraphs.text: Beavers are small animals that can make big changes in the places where they live. One way they do this is by piling tree branches, sticks, and mud across a stream. This makes a dam.

The dam blocks the stream's flow. The water in the stream backs up behind the dam, forming a beaver pond. Beaver ponds are home to many plants and animals. Fish, frogs, turtles, and birds live in and around the water. Larger animals such as moose and raccoons visit the pond to find food.

After a while, the beavers stop taking care of the dam, and it starts to leak. Sometimes a beaver dam breaks, letting all the water pour out. But usually water just seeps out through small holes in the dam. Little by little, the water drips out of the pond and back into the stream.

Over time, the bottom of the old pond dries out. It becomes a beaver meadow. The colorful wildflowers growing in the meadow bring in butterflies and bees. And all this happens because the beavers built a dam.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about sweat.

paragraphs.text: When you get hot, your skin gets wet. That is sweat! But sweating doesn't start in your skin. It starts in your brain.

The temperature inside the human body is usually about 98 degrees Fahrenheit. Your brain works hard to keep your body at this temperature, because a stable temperature helps the body work better. If your body gets much hotter than usual, your brain steps in to cool it down.
First, your brain sends a signal to your body, telling it to sweat. The sweat is made under your skin. It comes out of tiny holes called pores.
When your skin gets wet, it helps you cool down. The heat from your body turns the sweat into a gas. The gas rises into the air and pulls the heat away from your skin. So, you feel cooler.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about banana plants.

paragraphs.text: People all over the world eat bananas. But bananas can only grow in certain parts of the world. That's because banana plants need warm, wet weather to thrive. In some hot, rainy jungles, you can find hundreds of different kinds of bananas.

Banana plants look a lot like trees, but they are actually not trees at all. Instead of woody tree trunks, banana plants have thick stems made of long leaves. Some banana plants can grow over forty feet high. That's higher than most houses!

Farmers call a row of bananas on a banana plant a "hand," and the bananas on the hand are called "fingers." Each hand has fourteen to twenty fingers. A banana plant can grow about two hundred bananas, or fingers, in all.
After the bananas are picked, the banana plant dies. Then, baby banana plants appear around the bottom of the old plant. After some time, the new plants get taller and grow more bananas.

paragraphs.text: People also use solar energy to make electricity. They can do this with solar cells, which are made of special materials. When sunlight hits a solar cell, the solar cell changes the sunlight into electricity.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about rainforests.

paragraphs.text: Rainforests are the wettest places on Earth. Between fifty-five and four hundred inches of rain may fall in a year. That's a lot of rain! The Amazon, in South America, is the world's largest rainforest. Other rainforests are found in many different parts of the world.

The rain that falls in a rainforest supports many kinds of living things. In fact, more types of plants and animals live in rainforests than anywhere else on Earth. Some of these plants and animals are still being discovered. Every few days, scientists find something new living in the rainforest.

The plants that grow in the rainforests are very important for the Earth. This is because plants soak up a gas called carbon dioxide. Too much carbon dioxide in the air can cause the Earth to get warmer. So, when rainforest plants absorb carbon dioxide, they help the Earth stay cool.

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about submarines.

paragraphs.text: A submarine is a special kind of boat. It can float on the water like other boats, but it can go underwater, too. Submarines can take people deep down under the sea.

Submarines come in different sizes. Some submarines are small. Scientists use small submarines to study animals deep in the ocean. Other submarines are large. They can be longer than a football field. Some of these submarines can stay underwater for many months.

Most submarines have big tanks inside them. When the submarine needs to go underwater, the tanks are filled with water. This makes the submarine descend into the sea. To make the submarine come back up, the water is pushed out, and the tanks fill up with air. The air makes the submarine float.
There are many places in the ocean where people have never visited. Submarines can help us reach these places. Who knows what we might find in the world below the waves?

content.text: Listen and read along with the passage about beaver dams.

paragraphs.text: Beavers are small animals that can make big changes in the places where they live. One way they do this is by piling tree branches, sticks, and mud across a stream. This makes a dam.

The dam blocks the stream's flow. The water in the stream backs up behind the dam, forming a beaver pond. Beaver ponds are home to many plants and animals. Fish, frogs, turtles, and birds live in and around the water. Larger animals such as moose and raccoons visit the pond to find food.

After a while, the beavers stop taking care of the dam, and it starts to leak. Sometimes a beaver dam breaks, letting all the water pour out. But usually water just seeps out through small holes in the dam. Little by little, the water drips out of the pond and back into the stream.

Over time, the bottom of the old pond dries out. It becomes a beaver meadow. The colorful wildflowers growing in the meadow bring in butterflies and bees. And all this happens because the beavers built a dam.

After a while, the beavers stop taking care of the dam, and it starts to leak. Sometimes a beaver dam breaks, letting all the water pour out. But usually water just seeps out through small holes in the dam. Little by little, the water drips out of the pond and back into the stream.

Over time, the bottom of the old pond dries out. It becomes a beaver meadow. The colorful wildflowers growing in the meadow bring in butterflies and bees. And all this happens because the beavers built a dam.
